P1.1.text: Technical Trade School | Universal Technical Institute

P1.2.text: UTI offers hands-on programs in automotive, diesel, welding, HVACR, and more. Discover your future at a leading trade school.

P1.3.text: Getting started is easy! Just take 60 seconds to fill out the form.

P1.4.text: 5 Ways Students May Help Fund Their Training

P1.5.text: Paying for training isn’t one-size-fits-all. Universal Technical Institute has helped thousands of students build personalized funding plans, and we can help build yours too.

P1.6.text: Pell Grants, student loans, & Parent PLUS loans can help bridge the gap.

P1.7.text: UTI has institutional, relocation, commuter and other grant opportunities. 10

P1.8.text: Apply through UTI, Scholarship Universe & TechForce—even while enrolled! 10

P1.9.text: Some employers may offer repayment help or other incentives to grads they hire. 14

P1.10.text: Some students can pursue roles in the field before graduating 36

P1.11.text: UTI Trade School: Training Built for Your Future

P1.12.text: You’ve got goals, and we’re here to help you reach them. 1 At Universal Technical Institute (UTI), you can prepare for your future faster than a 4-year college. Explore how we can help make it happen.

P1.13.text: Get a Firsthand Look at UTI

P1.14.text: Picture yourself in a supportive student community at a technical training school where small classes encourage focused learning. In hands-on labs, passionate instructors will guide you in using the same tools and equipment as techs in the field. 18 You’ll tackle challenges that mirror the real world while developing skills to get closer to where you want to be. See it for yourself.

P1.17.text: UTI’s vocational trade school can help you gain the skills and confidence to pursue what you love.

P1.19.text: Explore answers to common questions about our technical school programs and admissions.

P1.20.text: Tips, success stories and industry info.

P2.2.text: Universal Technical Institute, Inc. is a leading provider of technical training in trades from automotive to welding.

P2.3.text: Approximately 285,000 students have graduated from UTI's campuses located across the U.S.

P2.4.text: To change the world one life at a time by helping people achieve their dreams. This is the underlying reason for our existence and the reason we come to work every day.

P2.6.text: Our reputation is the basis of our growing brand. Making our brand more powerful is essential to achieving our vision.

P2.8.text: We embrace change and continuous improvement.

P2.9.text: We deliver meaningful outcomes for our students and stakeholders.

P3.1.text: Trade & Vocational School Locations | Find a Campus

P3.2.text: Find campus details, programs and tour opportunities near you.

P3.3.text: 18 Many programs can be completed in less than a year, so you can start looking for roles in the industry sooner than the traditional four-year route. 7 Explore our campuses to find one that fits your goals and lifestyle.

P3.4.text: Explore the hands-on programs and advanced training options available at each UTI trade school location. If you’re not sure which one is right for you, schedule a tour to get a glimpse into what life is like at a specific campus.

P1.2.text: Help future-proof your workforce with scalable learning solutions that leverage 130+ years of adult education and 20+ years of employer partnerships.

P1.3.text: Strategic Education, Inc. is leading the charge for modern, future-proof learning

P1.4.text: With roots in education that span more than a century, we know where learning has been and we’re shaping where it’s going next.

P1.6.text: Customize your choices. From our wholly owned tuition assistance platform to accredited degrees, non-degree skill pathways, coding schools and more.

P1.7.text: Together, we’ll create a dynamic learning environment where every role has the potential to evolve and every learned skill opens new doors.

P1.8.text: Our mission drives everything we do.

P1.9.text: Our latest developments and media coverage.

P1.10.text: Transforming education requires highly talented people.

P2.1.text: About - Company Info - Our Mission, Strategic Education, Inc.

P2.2.text: Strategic Education, Inc. is dedicated to enabling economic mobility with education.

P2.3.text: With a focus on improving college affordability, student engagement, and workforce readiness, we are supporting the growing majority of nontraditional students and ensuring that our graduates have the skills required to succeed in today’s jobs.

P2.4.text: For an overview of our business, see our Company Profile.

P3.1.text: Degrees and Certificates From Strayer University and Capella University | Universities

P3.2.text: Give employees affordable, flexible degree and certificate programs built for working adults—find job-relevant options in healthcare, IT, business and more.

P3.3.text: Our accredited universities prioritize accessibility to high-quality education for working adults, offering flexible pricing options, including tuition-covered pathways.

P3.4.text: Level the playing field with tuition-covered degree options

P3.5.text: Strayer University and Capella University proudly offer Tuition Assistance Aligned Pricing (TAAP), aligning the cost of select degrees to match the annual dollar amount of your education benefit, meaning no out-of-pocket tuition cost for your employees.

P3.6.text: Strayer University also offers Degrees@Work—a fixed-fee tuition model that provides employers with a predictable, annual investment while giving employees access to fully covered courses and degree programs.

P3.7.text: Capella University: advanced online degrees for the modern world

P3.8.text: Empower your team with bachelor’s, master’s and doctoral programs that prioritize their time via flexible learning formats—allowing learners to earn their degrees on their terms.

P3.10.text: Innovative learning formats: FlexPath, where learners proceed at their own pace, and GuidedPath, which offers more structure.

P3.11.text: Professionally aligned degrees that can help students meet current and future challenges in their chosen field.

P3.12.text: Programs that are competency-based and designed for working professionals to provide immediately applicable skills.

P3.13.text: Support for every step of your learners’ academic journey, from enrollment to graduation.

P3.14.text: Provide your workforce with the flexibility they need to pursue higher education. Capella's groundbreaking FlexPath learning format, available in select programs, allows employees to customize their learning experience and pursue their goals on their own terms.

P3.15.text: Work and learn at the same time: Your employees can take one or two courses at a time.

P3.16.text: Leverage knowledge: Employees can apply their current experiences to their coursework and focus on new learning skills and competencies.

P3.17.text: Enjoy comprehensive learning support: Your employees will have the support of an academic team including a course instructor and academic coach.

P3.18.text: More than 1,000 organizations – including corporations and health care organizations – invest in their employees by partnering with Capella University to offer access to tuition savings and other education benefits.

P3.19.text: Strayer University: 130+ years of educating working adults

P3.20.text: Empower your employees with a variety of associate, bachelor’s and master’s degrees. Strayer features a selection of online, on-campus and hybrid learning options for your employees to learn where and when they prefer.

P3.21.text: Smart affordability that makes quality education cost-effective and manageable for your employees.
